Type: fabric drum pendant lamp
Use: general light over a table or room center; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: woven linen-look fabric shade, matte black metal rod and canopy
Colors: light warm beige, matte black
Shape: wide round drum shade with diffuser, hangs on a slim black rod from round canopy, medium, soft
Feel: soft, warm, calm
Goes with: light wood, neutral textiles, white walls, black accents; Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Basics Pendant Lamp - 15.7" x 15.7" x 60", Matte Black
product.description: Fabric shade: gracefully diffuses light and offers a round shape for a visually pleasing profile Metal base: sturdy metal base offers long-lasting strength and a sleek appearance Modern style: coordinates effortlessly with surrounding contemporary or transitional decor Small size: relatively small size makes it a great choice for a bedroom, kitchen, living room, or office Simple set-up and warranty: designed to hang from the ceiling; assembles quickly and easily (screwdriver and light bulb needed, not included); backed by an Amazon Basics 1-year limited warranty
